evals.prompt: I want to add a way for users to pin important notes to the top of their list in notes-app. There's no intent.md or spec for this yet, I just want to get something moving. Can you help me figure out what we're building?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes no intent.md exists and starts at Capture Intent rather than jumping to a spec or code. Interviews for problem/outcome/affected users/constraints/success criteria instead of inventing them. Writes intent.md using assets/intent-template.md structure. Explicitly flags it as a draft needing human approval and does not silently promote it to an approved spec or start implementing.
expectations: Identifies that the correct stage is Capture Intent (no intent.md / spec.md / plan.md exists yet for pinning)
Produces or proposes an intent.md-shaped artifact (problem, outcome, affected users/systems, constraints, success criteria, open questions)
Does not write implementation code or a step-by-step technical plan
Explicitly asks for human approval / flags the intent as a draft rather than treating it as approved
Does not silently invent unstated product decisions as settled facts

evals.prompt: Here's the intent doc for note tagging that we already got approved (attached as intent-tagging.md). Let's move this forward.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the approved intent.md and advances to Requirements & Design rather than re-deriving intent or jumping straight to a plan/implementation. Produces a spec.md-shaped artifact covering functional requirements, states, data/integration requirements, acceptance criteria, and traceability back to the intent, using assets/spec-template.md. Carries forward the intent's open questions (tag case-sensitivity, tag limit) rather than silently resolving them, and flags the spec as needing human approval before Plan Mode.
expectations: Identifies the correct stage as Requirements & Design because an approved intent.md already exists
Does not re-ask the Capture Intent interview questions that intent.md already answers
Produces a spec.md-shaped artifact with functional requirements and acceptance criteria, not a step-by-step implementation plan
Carries forward at least one open question from the intent (tag case-sensitivity or tag limit) rather than silently deciding it
States that the spec needs human approval before proceeding to Plan Mode / implementation

evals.prompt: We're getting reports today that some users' notes show stale content right after they edit and save it -- looks like a caching bug in prod. No ticket exists yet for this. What's our process here?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a production incident with no existing ticket/intent, and routes it through Maintain / Close the Loop: diagnose with constrained/read-only investigation first, then write the finding as a new intent.md (not jump straight into an unreviewed prod fix), and note that it should be routed through human triage before restarting the lifecycle.
expectations: Identifies this as entering the lifecycle via a production incident (Maintain / Close the Loop), not via Capture Intent for a fresh feature
Proposes read-only / diagnostic investigation before proposing or making any code change
Produces the finding as an intent.md-shaped artifact rather than an implementation plan or direct fix
States the finding needs to route through human triage before the lifecycle restarts
Does not claim the incident is resolved without executable evidence
